title: Topic documents concern file (.claude/topic-docs.yaml)
description: Consumer-side single source of truth for the topic-docs convention. Every key is optional; absent keys mean the documented defaults.

contract_dir.description: Contract-slice root, relative to the repo root. Holds one <slug>/ directory per topic on the task branch; pruned before merge.

memory_dir.description: Memory-tier root, relative to the repo root. Self-ignoring (contains a .gitignore with '*'). Holds <slug>/ slices plus the reserved concern directories handoffs/ and reviews/.

contract_tier.description: branch: contract kinds commit on the task branch and are pruned before merge (default). local: contract kinds join the memory tier; the PR-description paste is the only publication surface.

vault_backend.description: Knowledge-vault seam backend for the durable tier. 'docs' (default) promotes into the in-repo docs/ tree via git mv. Other values name an enabled backend documented by the consuming repo; skills degrade to 'docs' when the named backend's tools are unavailable. GitBook is reserved but not enabled as a vault_backend value (see docs/adr/0001-defer-gitbook-as-knowledge-vault-backend.md): preserve an existing key, report it as deferred, and use docs for durable writes.
